body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 6 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target takes 1 Fire Damage. Independently, the center space is brightly lit until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Exclude up to two chosen creatures.
Deal +1 Fire Damage to one hit target, or give one hit target Burning.

rider.title: Fire Thread
rider.html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.
